headline: Nigel Farage says a Reform government would impose a blanket visa ban on Sudanese nationals, arguing that Britain’s immigration policies have had serious consequences. The proposal comes as Sudan remains engulfed in a brutal civil war between the Sudanese Armed Forces, which has ties to the Muslim Brotherhood and Islamist factions like Al Baraa bin Malik Brigade, and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF), which stand accused of ethnic cleansing and war crimes. The conflict has created one of the world’s worst humanitarian disasters. More than 14 million people have been displaced, around 20 million face acute hunger, and estimates suggest over 200,000 people may have been killed since the war began in 2023.
